feed.title: Add to your calendar
feed.intro: See your predicted period in Google, Apple or Outlook Calendar. It updates itself, and only the label you choose is shown.
feed.label: Calendar label
feed.labelHelp: Discreet on purpose: the default is just a moon. Anyone glancing at your calendar sees only this.
feed.fertileHelp: Off by default. Adds the estimated fertile window.
feed.estimateHelp: Adds "(estimate)" so a prediction is never mistaken for a fact.
feed.rotateHelp: A new link replaces the old one: calendars using the old link stop updating.
feed.rotateMessage: The old link stops working right away. You will need to add the new one to each calendar app.
feed.offMessage: Your calendars stop updating. You can create a new link later.
feed.urlOnce: This is shown only once. Copy it now and keep it private: anyone with the link can see your dates.

google.title: Google Calendar
google.steps: On a computer, open Google Calendar. Next to “Other calendars” press +, choose “From URL”, paste the link and press “Add calendar”.

apple.title: iPhone, iPad, Mac
apple.steps: iPhone: Settings, Calendar, Accounts, Add Account, Other, Add Subscribed Calendar, paste the link. Mac: Calendar app, File, New Calendar Subscription.

outlook.title: Outlook
outlook.steps: Open Outlook on the web. Choose Add calendar, then “Subscribe from web”, paste the link and give it a name.

how.delay: Calendar apps refresh subscribed calendars every few hours, so changes can take a while to show up.

errors.generic: That didn't work. Please try again.

feed.private: This link is private: anyone who has it can see these dates. Don't share it. You can reset it anytime.
feed.syncing: Your link is active. For safety it is only shown once; reset it to get a new one.
